CustomField.description: Decorative circles in the top-right corner of a Static Content widget that has a Section Background (ignored without one). Green circles: a tinted filled circle and emerald outline circles. Purple circles: the same with medium purple outlines. Blank means no circles. Drawn in CSS; hidden from assistive technology and on narrow screens.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional decorative circles in the top-right corner. Needs a Section Background; blank means none.
CustomField.label: Section Accent
